Ravi Systems · Junior Backend Engineer · Lahore (on-site)

Ravi Systems builds billing software for pharmacies across Punjab. We're hiring a junior backend engineer to join our platform team of six.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs in Node.js and Express.
- Write and tune SQL queries for our PostgreSQL database.
- Write unit and integration tests for the services you build.
- Review pull requests and pair with senior engineers.
- Help debug production issues using logs and metrics.

What we're looking for
- A degree in Computer Science or a related field (fresh graduates welcome).
- Good understanding of HTTP, JSON and REST API design.
- Comfortable writing SQL: joins, indexes, transactions.
- Has used Git in a team.
- Clear written English.

Nice to have
- Experience with authentication (sessions or JWT).
- Any project deployed to a real server.
